talk.jaymoskingdoms.captive.ask.royal: Look at me. I am the rightful ruler of %1$s, and something wears my face on my throne. It's %2$s to the %3$s. Break these chains and take me home, and you'll be rewarded as no one ever was.
news.jaymoskingdoms.stolen_crown.found_o: The thing on the throne of %2$s was not %1$s! Its face came off, and it fled to the %3$s. The true ruler is missing.
news.jaymoskingdoms.stolen_crown.keeper: %1$s keeps the throne of %2$s until its ruler is found.
news.jaymoskingdoms.stolen_crown.hint.fa: %1$s searches for its ruler. A herder swears he saw strangers digging %3$s off to the %2$s.
news.jaymoskingdoms.stolen_crown.hint.ca: %1$s still searches. Look for a fresh cairn of stones on open ground, %3$s to the %2$s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stolen_crown.home: %1$s is home in %2$s and crowned again! %3$s brought them back.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.stolen_crown.slip.he: My heir %s will sit this throne after me. A fine child.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.stolen_crown.slip.cr: Our %s has flown over these walls since the first stone was laid.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.stolen_crown.slip.se: Welcome to %s, traveller. My seat, and my people.
%1$s of %2$s decrees a toll on every road in the realm, to be paid by its own people too.
%1$s of %2$s calls the guards down off the walls. "They frighten the people," says the decree.
%1$s of %2$s cancels tonight's feast, and every feast after it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.stolen_crown.grumble: A toll on our own road? The old crown would never have.
No guards on the walls. Whose idea is that? Not the crown I knew.
No feast. Not tonight, not ever. What's come over the throne?
My love doesn't know me. Looks right through me, calls me by another name. Something's wrong in %s.
That isn't my blood on the throne of %s. I'd swear it on my life.
I have served the crown of %s for thirty years. The one wearing it now has never met me.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.stolen_crown.challen: Forgive me, Your Grace. What was my father's name? You stood at his grave.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.stolen_crown.stammer: Your... father. Of course. A good man. Back to your post.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.stolen_crown.gates_s: Turn back, stranger. The gates of %s are shut till our ruler is found.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.stolen_crown.search: To the %s! Search every hollow till we find them.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.stolen_crown.no_trad: No trade with strangers. Not while our ruler is missing.
